equity.level_reason: Race/ethnicity and age differences in case distribution by vaccination status are reported and described (e.g. 59% of fully vaccinated cases were non-Hispanic White) without being framed as a disparity or explained.

notes: Odds ratios and the 0.1% infection rate are arithmetic on counts, and no model is described, so regression_fields is null. The fully vaccinated denominator (188,907) comes from coverage data and is not listed as an analysed source. The chi-square and Fisher tests are rated primary because the Abstract's demographic and severity claims rest on them.
view_issues: The Abstract attaches a single p<0.001 to the 'less severe disease' comparisons, but several Table 2 symptoms are non-significant (e.g. rash p=0.09, proctitis p=0.08, tenesmus p=1.0).
